# docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md
max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
The 2026-09 load test (docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md) measured 0.9 s at 100 lines, under the 2.0 s checkout timeout.
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Every cart line reserves stock. The load test (docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md) shows p99 latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines and 3.9 s at 80, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Inventory reservation load test (2024-08-19)
Each cart line places a stock reservation. p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 40 | 0.8 s |
| 60 | 1.6 s |
| 80 | 3.9 s |
| 100 | 7.2 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.
# Inventory reservation load test (2026-09-08)
Run after the reservation service was replaced on 2026-09-01 (reservations are now batched). p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 60 | 0.5 s |
| 100 | 0.9 s |
| 150 | 1.7 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.

steps.reasoning_content: The newer load test, run after the reservation service was replaced, supports 100, matching the config and design, so only ADR 0007 at 60 is out of date. I'll keep 100, record that decision, and mark ADR 0007 as superseded.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p docs/decisions && cat > docs/decisions/0008-cart-item-limit-100.md <<'EOF'
# Decision 0008: Cart item limit is 100
Status: Accepted (2026-11-01)
Supersedes: docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md
Resolves: issue #12

## Context
ADR 0007 set the limit to 60, based on the 2024-08 load test (p99 3.9 s at 80 lines, 7.2 s at 100, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout). The reservation service was replaced on 2026-09-01 and reservations are now batched. The 2026-09 load test (docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md) measured p99 of 0.5 s at 60 lines, 0.9 s at 100 and 1.7 s at 150. Commit 50709b8 raised the limit to 100 in config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md but left ADR 0007 unchanged, which caused the inconsistency.

## Decision
A cart holds at most 100 items. `config/cart.yaml` (`max_items.default: 100`) and `docs/design/cart.md` already match.
100 is kept rather than 150 because 150 lines leaves only 0.3 s of headroom under the 2.0 s timeout.

## Consequences
ADR 0007 is marked superseded. The 2024-08 load test is historical and no longer applies to the current reservation service.
EOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md'
s=open(p).read().replace("Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)","Status: Superseded by docs/decisions/0008-cart-item-limit-100.md (2026-11-01). Originally accepted 2024-09-02.",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git status --short

steps.message:
The cart limit is 100, and the repository now agrees on it. I haven't committed anything or touched the issue on GitHub.

- **Cause:** `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` were raised to 100 in commit 50709b8, but ADR 0007 still said 60. ADR 0007 rested on the 2024-08 load test. The reservation service was replaced after that, and the 2026-09 load test shows p99 of 0.9 s at 100 lines against the 2.0 s checkout timeout.
- **Decision record:** I added `docs/decisions/0008-cart-item-limit-100.md`. It keeps 100 rather than 150, because 150 lines leaves only 0.3 s of headroom (p99 1.7 s).
- **ADR 0007:** I changed its status to "Superseded by 0008". The rest of the file is unchanged.
- **Where the record lives:** The existing ADR lives in `docs/adr/`, but you asked for `docs/decisions/`, so the new record is in a new directory. If you'd rather keep a single location, 0008 could move into `docs/adr/`.

I can commit this and close the issue if you want.
